channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Saiba quem é Douglas Ruas, eleito governador do RJ após decisão do TSE
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL), 37, was elected governor of Rio de Janeiro in the first round after the TSE annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes. With 50.88% of valid votes, Ruas, a police officer and son of Captain Nelson Ruas, will take office with Vice-Governor Fernanda Louback. His government plan prioritizes public security with the Escudo Fluminense and includes proposals in health, education, and expansion of the military police force.

item.title: Jair Bolsonaro vai indicar ministros se Flávio vencer eleições, diz Eduardo
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro stated that Jair Bolsonaro would influence ministerial appointments if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 elections. The statement was made during an interview with SBT News, highlighting the former president's potential role in shaping a PL government.

item.title: Eduardo diz que buscará sanção dos EUA a Moraes se Flávio Bolsonaro vencer
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro said he will push for the reinstatement of U.S. sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes if his brother Flávio Bolsonaro wins the 2026 election. He emphasized his active role in the race against President Lula, focusing on foreign policy and security.

item.title: Flávio fala em “guerra espiritual” e recebe apoio de bispo em culto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, stated during a service at Maracanãzinho in Rio de Janeiro that Brazil is facing a 'spiritual war.' At the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the Assembleia de Deus Ministério de Madureira, Bishop Samuel Ferreira praised the senator and announced he would request votes for him. The speech highlighted religion as a central campaign theme.

item.title: Sidônio tira férias da Secom para se dedicar à campanha de Lula
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, Ministry of Communications chief, will take a leave to focus on Lula's reelection campaign following the first round of 2026 polls. The PT campaign restructures with new coordinators including Camilo Santana and Rui Costa, amid internal criticism after the electoral results.

item.title: Ratinho Jr anuncia apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno: 'Vamos caminhar juntos pelo futuro do nosso Brasil'
item.description: Ratinho Jr (PSD) endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro for the runoff, strengthening center-right alliances. Flávio leads polls against Lula, backed by parties like Republicanos, Novo, and Podemos.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro acerta apoio de Ratinho Jr à sua candidatura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured the support of Ratinho Jr (PSD), governor of Paraná, for his presidential candidacy, with an official announcement coming in the next few days. The PSD maintains a neutral stance in the second phase of the elections, but the governor's decision also covers state races with a runoff on October 25th. Ratinho Jr had been mentioned as a potential presidential candidate but withdrew for personal reasons.

item.title: Com Ruas eleito no RJ, cinco estados e DF terão 2º turno para governador
item.description: The TSE annulled votes for Garotinho in RJ, securing Douglas Ruas' first-round election win. As a result, six states and the Federal District will hold gubernatorial runoffs on October 25, the same date as the presidential race between Lula and Bolsonaro.

item.title: Ex-Zorra Total e miss: saiba quem é Fernanda Louback, vice de Ruas
item.description: Fernanda Louback, former TV Globo actress and Miss Rio winner, becomes Rio's vice-governor alongside Douglas Ruas after a political career marked by conservative stances, Bolsonaro family alliances and Chamber controversies.

item.title: Lindbergh pede à PF que inclua Flávio em investigação de fraude no INSS
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a crime report with the Federal Police requesting the inclusion of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in investigations into INSS fraud, also asking for a breach of his bank and tax secrecy.

item.title: Campanha de Lula rejeita ‘limpa’ em cargos do Centrão
item.description: Lula's campaign, led by Camilo Santana, rejected firing officials from centrist parties supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, prioritizing governability and dialogue with dissidents. Minister José Guimarães advocates for cuts, but the PT strategy emphasizes differentiating platforms and securing sectoral backing.

item.title: Risco país cai para 110 pontos, menor nível desde 2020
item.description: Brazil's sovereign risk premium fell to 110 basis points, its lowest since February 2020, driven by market expectations of fiscal discipline under a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration following the first round of the 2026 elections. The indicator approached Mexico's level, which holds an investment-grade rating, while Brazil remains in the speculative grade.

item.title: Douglas Ruas é confirmado governador eleito do Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) was confirmed as the elected governor of Rio de Janeiro after the judiciary recalculated votes and excluded those of Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), annulled by the TSE. With 50.88% of valid votes, Ruas secured victory in the first round, ending a tight race.

item.title: Governo federal aciona programa de proteção para Ana Elisa após ameaças
item.description: The Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship activated the State Protection Program of Minas Gerais to ensure the safety of elected federal deputy Ana Elisa (PT-MG) following threats of death and rape. The measure includes joint action by federal and state teams, as well as the involvement of the Federal Police to investigate the threats on social media.

item.title: Lula desafia Flávio a dizer o que estará no corte de R$ 250 bilhões
item.description: Lula challenges Flávio Bolsonaro to detail the R$250 billion spending cut, questioning if it will affect social policies. Flávio's team studies measures like replacing the fiscal framework and revoking administrative acts.

item.title: Sidônio tira férias do governo para se dedicar exclusivamente à campanha de Lula no segundo turno
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, head of Secom, will take leave to focus exclusively on Lula's re-election campaign in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. The move follows internal criticism of the PT's strategy after the first round, where Flávio led with 47.03% against Lula's 45.16%. The campaign will intensify attacks on the opponent, highlighting risks to social programs and labor rights.

item.title: Vitória de Doulgas Ruas é confirmada pelo TRE após retotalização dos votos
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Regional Electoral Court (TRE-RJ) confirmed Douglas Ruas (PL) as the winner of the gubernatorial race following the recount of valid votes, raising his share from 49.27% to 50.88% and eliminating the need for a runoff. The ruling followed the annulment of 274,411 votes for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), convicted of administrative misconduct, leaving only Ruas and Eduardo Paes (PSD) as viable candidates. Paes publicly acknowledged the judicial decision, underscoring respect for democratic institutions.

item.title: Votos de Garotinho são anulados e Douglas Ruas é eleito no 1º turno no RJ
item.description: The TSE-RJ conducted a recount of votes for governor in Rio de Janeiro, confirming Douglas Ruas (PL) as the winner in the first round. The annulment of 274,411 votes for Anthony Garotinho, decided by the TSE, raised Ruas's share from 49.27% to 50.88%, exceeding the absolute majority threshold. Eduardo Paes (PSD), who led the race, withdrew his appeal and acknowledged Ruas's victory.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai receber faixa presidencial de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that if elected president, he will receive the presidential sash from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is imprisoned for attempted coup d'état. During a motorcycle rally in São Gonçalo (RJ), Flávio also announced proposals such as declaring war on drug trafficking, increasing punishment for cell phone thieves, and reducing the age of criminal responsibility.

item.title: Campanhas de Flávio e Lula planejam gesto político em dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: The campaign teams of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are planning symbolic political gestures on October 12, the feast day of Our Lady of Aparecida, following a fake news story falsely linking the PL candidate to removing her title as patron saint of Brazil. While Flávio avoids visiting Aparecida and takes a more discreet stance, Lula is expected to leverage the date with religious backing. The Catholic Church has entered the race by criticizing the political exploitation of Marian devotion.

item.title: Hugo Calderano derrota Félix Lebrun e avança para semifinal do China Smash
item.description: Hugo Calderano defeated Félix Lebrun 4-1 and advanced to the China Smash semifinals in Beijing. The Brazilian player will face Taiwan's Lin Yun-ju in the next round. Throughout the tournament, Calderano eliminated four opponents, including the French player who took his bronze medal at the 2024 Olympics.

item.title: PF desmente Veja e Padilha aciona Justiça sobre fake news contra Lula
item.description: The Federal Police denied the existence of a statement by Daniel Vorcaro regarding alleged funding for a documentary about Lula, contradicting a report by Veja magazine. Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha notified the magazine to publish a right of reply, claiming the accusations are false and lack evidential support. Lawyers from the Prerrogativas group have requested a forensic analysis of the audio released by Veja, suspecting AI manipulation and labeling it a potential electoral attack.

item.title: Campanha de Lula acusa Meta de interferência eleitoral e vai acionar o TSE
item.description: Lula's campaign accuses Meta of electoral interference and announces legal action with the TSE and ANPD. The team claims technical restrictions on the candidate's Instagram account and unequal engagement favor Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio diz que Jair Bolsonaro colocará faixa presidencial nele e promete entregar o Brasil ‘nas mãos de Deus’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed his father, Jair Bolsonaro, will place the presidential sash on him at the inauguration and pledged to hand Brazil over to 'the hands of God'. At a rally in São Gonçalo, he blamed those who tried to 'silence' the former president for his own victory and reiterated his promise to pardon Jair.

item.title: Ana Elisa é ativo digital de Lula e é arriscado afastá-la, diz Bites
item.description: Bites warns that pulling Ana Elisa off Lula’s campaign would be a digital risk, as she has expanded her online following and engagement. Despite backlash over past statements, her influence grew faster than other PT allies. The agency notes Lula needs better content strategy to convert engagement into votes.

item.title: Douglas Ruas é eleito governador do RJ, após retotalização de votos
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL) was elected governor of Rio de Janeiro after the TSE annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes (Republicanos), giving him over half of the valid votes, securing first-round victory. The Regional Electoral Court of Rio conducted a vote retally to confirm the result, with official proclamation scheduled for October 15th.

item.title: Wagner Moura e outros nomes do cinema assinam carta aberta sobre eleições
item.description: Prominent Brazilian filmmakers including Wagner Moura, Petra Costa, Fernando Meirelles, and Kleber Mendonça Filho signed an open letter urging international attention for the 2026 runoff election between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The letter criticizes promises to rewrite the 1988 Constitution and alleged foreign interference.

item.title: Lula critica ‘tesouraço’ e questiona onde Flávio Bolsonaro fará corte de R$ 250 bilhões
item.description: Lula questions where Flávio Bolsonaro will make the 250 billion cut, saying cuts usually harm the poor. Flávio denies cutting pensions and BPC, claiming he will increase family benefits. The debate takes place amid global uncertainties such as wars and inflation.

item.title: Novo pede cassação da chapa de Lula por suposto uso de verba sindical
item.description: The Brazilian Social Democracy Party (Novo) filed a lawsuit with the Superior Electoral Court requesting the disqualification of the Lula-Alckmin ticket, accusing misuse of union funds from ANDES-SN in support committees for Lula's re-election. The action seeks ineligibility for those responsible for alleged economic power abuse.

item.title: Romaria Fluvial reúne fiéis em homenagem a Nossa Senhora de Nazaré
item.description: The Romaria Fluvial do Círio de Nazaré gathered approximately 50,000 faithful in Belém, with the image of Our Lady of Nazaré parading along Guajará Bay in boats, including the Brazilian Navy's Hydrooceanographic Ship Garnier Sampaio. The procession, traditional since 1986, aims to honor Our Lady of Nazaré and involves 14 official processions, with support from the Armed Forces for the nighttime event.

item.title: Lula endurece ataques a Flávio na TV com caso Master; senador promete reajustar o Bolsa Família
item.description: Lula escalated attacks against Flávio Bolsonaro in electoral ads, invoking the Banco Master case and accusing him of corruption and support for online betting. Flávio countered by reinforcing pledges like the readjustment of Bolsa Família. The PT campaign also flagged suspicions against running mate Alfredo Gaspar, whose allegations were dismissed by the Supreme Court.

item.title: Projeto cria o crime de traição à pátria no Código Penal
item.description: Bill 3362/26 introduces the crime of treason against the fatherland into the Brazilian Penal Code, with sentences of 8 to 20 years in prison and fines, targeting acts that undermine national sovereignty for foreign interests. The legislation, currently under review in the Chamber of Deputies, also provides enhanced penalties for public officials, electoral periods, or states of emergency, and now advances to specialized committees before congressional approval.

item.title: Sidônio Palmeira, ministro da Secom de Lula, tira férias para entrar de vez na campanha
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, Lula's Secretary of Communication, leaves office to fully engage in the PT campaign after internal criticism following the first round. The strategy includes reinforcing communication, partnering with Otávio Antunes, and strategic meetings for re-election. Figures like Rafael Fonteles and Camilo Santana gain prominence in campaign articulation and communication.

item.title: Lula defende a manutenção de programas sociais e diz que Flávio fará ‘tesouraço’
item.description: While campaigning in Natal (RN), Lula defended the preservation of social programs and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for promising R$250 billion in budget cuts, warning that the achievements built in the Northeast would be at risk. He highlighted initiatives such as minimum wage adjustments above inflation, the Farmácia Popular, and the expansion of federal institutions, emphasizing national sovereignty to mobilize voters for the second round.

item.title: Campanha de Lula acusa dona do Instagram e Facebook de interferir em favor de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula's reelection campaign accused Meta, owner of Facebook and Instagram, of interfering in the election in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro, announcing legal actions before the TSE and ANPD. The accusation was made on October 10, 2026.

item.title: Lula fala em 'escolha entre a verdade e a mentira' ato de campanha em Natal
item.description: During a campaign rally in Natal, President Lula framed the runoff as a choice between truth and lies, and endorsed Cadu de Lula, his running ally against Allyson Bezerra. He emphasized dialogue and responsible governance to overcome polarization.

item.title: Os números da disputa Flávio x Lula nas primeiras pesquisas do segundo turno
item.description: The first polls for the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro show mixed scenarios, with three institutes favoring the senator and one, Vox, keeping the president within technical tie range. The race remains tight following the first round, where Flávio narrowly led Lula. The election is set for October 25th.

item.title: Rodrigo Simas grava participação em Quem Ama Cuida
item.description: Rodrigo Simas recorded his appearance in the telenovela 'Quem Ama Cuida' and expressed support for President Lula in the runoff elections, emphasizing the importance of a healthy democracy. He also pointed out the polarization of the moment and encouraged dialogue between different opinions. His wife, Agatha Moreira, is also part of the telenovela's cast.

item.title: Grupo Lide, de Doria, organiza almoço de empresários com Flávio
item.description: The Lide Group, led by João Doria, is organizing a lunch with entrepreneurs and Flávio Bolsonaro on October 19, six days before the presidential runoff. The event, at the W Hotel in São Paulo, will be a debate on the political and economic scenario. The relationship between Doria and the Bolsonaro family has been marked by misunderstandings, especially during the pandemic.

item.title: Ipespe: Flávio tem 52,7% dos votos válidos contra 47,3% de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the Ipespe poll against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the 2026 second-round election with 52.7% of valid votes versus 47.3%. Voting is scheduled for October 25th. Flávio's campaign shows better performance in TV and radio advertising according to 43% of respondents.

item.title: Flávio não será eleito para fazer um novo governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The article examines how Brazilian presidents, since 2010, misinterpreted election results, like Dilma Rousseff, who confused her victory with Lula's and later faced impeachment. Flávio Bolsonaro will not be elected to form a new government modeled after Jair Bolsonaro, repeating the pattern of misreading electoral signals.

item.title: Projeto prevê doação de excedentes de mercados a famílias vulneráveis
item.description: Senator Jader Barbalho (MDB-PA) proposes the Prato Farto Program to donate surplus market foods to vulnerable families, addressing food insecurity in Brazil. The bill establishes cooperation with companies without tax exemptions and will be funded by FNPC and voluntary donations. The initiative seeks to transform wasted food into social support through institutions such as food banks and community kitchens.

item.title: José de Abreu cobra colegas para que votem contra o “fascismo”
item.description: Actor José de Abreu released a video calling on entertainment colleagues such as Selton Mello, Giovanna Antonelli, and Carolina Dieckmann to take a stand against what he calls 'fascism' in Brazil, without necessarily supporting Lula or the PT directly. He emphasized the importance of artistic resistance and cited figures like Anitta and Ana Paula Renault as examples of non-partisan stances.

item.title: ‘Retratar VEJA como antilulista ou pró-Bolsonaro é uma piada’, diz Glenn Greenwald
item.description: Glenn Greenwald defends VEJA against accusations of being anti-Lula and pro-Bolsonaro, recalling the magazine's collaboration in covering the Vaza-Jato leaks and its criticism of Sergio Moro's conduct. He says attacks on media are predictable but ridiculous given the publication's track record.

item.title: Conheça as propostas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro para a Cultura
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro propose different cultural policies focused on reducing regional concentration and improving incentives, but disagree on the state's role.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aposta em novos aliados, Michelle e vice para avançar no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro restructures his 2026 runoff campaign to gain ground on Lula in the Northeast, a region where he performed better than his father in 2022. With new alliances including Ronaldo Caiado and parties like Podemos and Republicanos, the candidate plans regional actions featuring Michelle Bolsonaro and running mate Alfredo Gaspar. The strategy aims to counter criticism and strengthen his image in one of the few areas where Lula won in the first round.

item.title: Poder e saber (por André Gustavo Stumpf)
item.description: Brazilian voters retired the 1988 generation of politicians, including figures like Sarney, Lula, Aécio Neves, and Marina Silva, leading to a major reconfiguration of the political landscape. Polling failures occurred, and a new cohort of politicians, many first-term legislators, will assume legislative power, reflecting a wave of renewal and a preference for less government and more private initiative.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest avalia propostas de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro: veja quais são
item.description: A new Quaest survey examines Brazilian opinions on campaign proposals from Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for the 2026 second-round elections, covering topics such as the end of the 6-for-1 work scale, amnesty for January 8 convicts, Supreme Court reforms, and the fight against organized crime.

item.title: Justiça italiana marca para o fim de outubro novo julgamento sobre extradição de Zambelli
item.description: The Italian judiciary has scheduled a new hearing for October 29 to reassess the extradition of former lawmaker Carla Zambelli, convicted in Brazil for armed stalking. The Italian court annulled the previous decision and requested additional guarantees regarding her health and prison treatment, dismissing the political persecution claim.

item.title: Aumentam agressões políticas em mês de luta contra violência à mulher
item.description: TSE data shows an 11-fold increase in political gender-based attacks between 2022 and 2026, rising from 15 to 177 cases, while human rights organizations recorded 134 incidents of political violence during the campaign leading up to the first round, with women being the primary victims. This context coincides with the National Day of Struggle Against Violence Against Women, established in memory of women who protested gender crimes in 1980.
